harborpass/renewal-policy: HarborPass current renewal policy: trial-1iy permanently replaces the customer-facing retention agreement for every notice and export request, regardless of renewal date, and governs subsequent features. send_on is renewal_on minus 14 calendar days. If completed_years >= 3, credit_cents = min(plan_cents * 15 // 100, 3600); otherwise credit_cents = 0. Autopay does not affect eligibility. All money is integer US cents; amount_due_cents = plan_cents - credit_cents. Notice fields remain exactly customer_id, send_on (YYYY-MM-DD), credit_cents, amount_due_cents. Export remains {csv: STRING, count: N}, preserving input order and duplicate IDs, with columns customer_id,send_on,credit_cents,amount_due_cents; header and every row end with LF; fields containing comma, double quote, CR or LF are quoted and internal double quotes doubled. Empty exports contain only the header and LF. Historical exception: support_replay case IOS-1842 retains approved release 1.0 behavior: send 21 calendar days before renewal; only autopay members with completed_years >= 2 receive min(plan_cents // 10, 2400) cents; other members receive zero credit. Its response remains {case_id: IOS-1842, notice: NOTICE}. Implementation keeps release_1_0_notice separate from current notice; export calls current notice. Source: trial-1iy, main.py and README.md. Verified with unittest discovery (8 test methods), public_tests/stage_4.json and public_tests/stage_3.json.
